report.summary: All three UI tests timed out (5 s) while waiting on /books to load after a register, delete, or navigation. The app's list_books() adds time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) on every /books render (app/main.py:150), so the page sometimes takes longer than the 5 s timeout. Fix first: remove the random delay from list_books (or make it deterministic and bounded in tests) and rerun the UI suite several times to confirm it is stable.

causes.title: Random 0-8 s delay in the books listing makes every /books page load intermittently exceed the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: The app's list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database (app/main.py:149-150). render_books() calls list_books() for every server-rendered /books page (app/main.py:256), and books_page() renders it on GET. tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7 sets the Playwright default timeout to 5000 ms. So whenever the random draw is above roughly 5 s, the navigation or click times out. The three failures hit different steps: test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui fails in Page.goto('/books') waiting for 'load'; test_deleted_book_disappears fails in the delete click, where the form POST redirects to /books and Playwright is still 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish'; test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf fails in the register submit click, where the POST redirects to /books and the navigation is still pending. The failure is random, not deterministic: other UI tests that also load /books (test_added_book_is_listed, test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input) passed in the same run, which fits a random delay. The cause is the app's timing, so this is flaky rather than a product bug or a test bug. Note that the 5 s timeout is the test-side setting that surfaces the delay, but the delay itself is not an intended behavior.
evidence: app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: / time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:250-256: render_books(...) builds "books": list_books(user["id"]) on every render
tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7: fail_fast sets page.set_default_timeout(5000) with docstring 'Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s'
test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui: playwright TimeoutError: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:51139/books", waiting until "load"
test_deleted_book_disappears: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... click action done / waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (the delete POST redirects to /books, app/main.py:340-346)
test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded ... click action done (register POST redirects to /books via logged_in_redirect, app/main.py:287-297)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:9-16 and 38-46: test_added_book_is_listed and test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input also load /books and passed in this run, consistent with a random delay
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py:150 (it has no reason to be in production code). If the delay is needed to test slow-server behavior, put it behind an explicit opt-in setting that is off by default, and give the slow-path tests their own longer timeouts. Then rerun the UI tests repeatedly (for example 10 times) to confirm they pass consistently. Do not just raise the 5 s timeout to hide the delay, since the random draw can still exceed any fixed limit.
